name: Beard
overview: Scripture addresses the beard both as a natural sign of manhood and as a matter of ceremonial significance. Leviticus 13 outlines the priestly examination of diseases affecting the beard, prescribing shaving only under specific conditions of uncleanness, illustrating the beard's role in holy distinction and purity. Additionally, Genesis 41:14 shows a cultural practice where shaving signified preparation and respect, as Joseph shaved before meeting Pharaoh. Together, these passages reveal that the beard carried both spiritual and cultural meaning in the biblical context.
